title: Today view widget
body:
The widget added at the Left screen (Today view) is great and very helpful since it has the ability to expand to see larger lists. 
However, it often randomly disappears, both from the today view widget stack as well as from the list of available widgets to choose when adding a new widget. 
5 stars if it stops disappearing, it is very frustrating!
